title: Root fillings separate the order-16 collision; the full dichotomy was already known
subject: The complexity of counting homomorphisms from closed 3-manifold groups into finite groups
conclusion: Dehn-filling parallel copies of the edge curves by square roots kills the reflection channels of the order-16 dihedral group, so interpolation recovers 4^m 8 P(G,4)/2^|V|, and an index-p theorem gives explicit chromatic coefficients for every group with an abelian normal subgroup of prime index acting nontrivially on its p-th powers. Hardness for every non-abelian group already follows from Galindo's 2026 Turaev-Viro dichotomy, which also predates HARD-3D-20261025-001's novelty claims.
